story.title: A Note and a Rope

panels.desc: A great stone hall inside the castle. A wide stone staircase leads up to a high door, but in the middle of the stairs there is a deep gap. At the edge of the gap stands a wooden signpost carved with three letters n, o, t — these three letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture — with a round red no symbol (a red circle with a diagonal line) painted beside the letters. Bun crouches, ready to hop over the gap; Hedgie grabs her red cape to stop her; Pip reads the sign in broken pieces; Fairy E flutters by the sign. In the hall stand a big round world globe on a wooden stand and a stone statue of a friendly lion with a big round nose; a red rose grows in a pot on one step. Hidden in the picture: the stone steps, the globe, the statue's nose, the rose. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.ko: 난 뛰어넘을 수 있어! 깡충, 깡충!

panels.ko: 돌계단 한가운데에 깊은 틈이 있어요. 번이 뛰어넘으려 하자 헤지가 말려요. '안 돼' 표지 앞에서 핍은 "낫-이!"

panels.desc: Fairy E taps the end of the wooden signpost with her star wand: a sparkling letter e appears, so it reads n o t e — these four letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture — the red no symbol vanishes in sparkles, and a small folded paper note tied with a red ribbon flutters out of the sign down into Hedgie's paws. Hedgie opens it: inside there is only a simple drawing of a coiled rope, no words. Bun and Pip lean in to look; Beads peers from Hedgie's flower. Hidden in the picture: the note, the drawing of the rope, the stone steps. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 요정 이가 톡! n-o-t 끝에 반짝 e 가 붙어 note 가 되자 표지에서 쪽지가 나와 헤지 손에 내려앉아요. 쪽지 안에는 밧줄 그림만 있어요.

panels.desc: High up in the stone wall of the hall a small window opens, and Grumble leans out wearing a fluffy blue bathrobe over his striped pajamas and nightcap, grumpy and sleepy, slowly lowering a long brown rope down toward the friends. On the bottom step a small brown puppy chews a white bone, wagging its tail. Bun reaches up for the rope; Hedgie holds the note; Pip looks up at the rope, reading it in pieces. Hidden in the picture: the rope, the robe, the bone, the stone steps, the puppy's nose. No letters anywhere.
panels.ko: 목욕 가운을 입은 그럼블이 창문에서 밧줄을 내려 줘요. 처음으로 친구들을 도와줬어요! 핍은 "랍-이!"

panels.desc: Bun swings across the gap on the rope with Pip clinging to her head and her red cape flying; Hedgie and Beads wait their turn holding the end of the rope; Fairy E sprinkles sparkles along it. Above, Grumble in his fluffy blue robe holds the rope tight in his window, peeking down with a tiny hidden smile; an ice cream cone sits on his windowsill. The globe and the potted red rose stand by the steps. Hidden in the picture: the rope, the robe, the ice cream cone, the rose, the globe. No letters anywhere.
panels.ko: 번이 밧줄을 타고 틈을 휙 건너요. 창문의 그럼블이 밧줄을 꼭 잡아 주며 몰래 웃어요.

ask.en: How does Bun go over the gap?

story.synopsis_ko: 돌계단 한가운데 깊은 틈이 있어요. 번이 뛰어넘으려 하자 헤지가 말려요. 핍은 "낫-이!" 요정 이가 '안 돼' 표지를 톡! 하자 쪽지(note)가 되고, 쪽지에는 밧줄 그림이 있어요. 목욕 가운을 입은 그럼블이 창문에서 밧줄을 내려 줘요. 처음으로 친구들을 도와줬어요!
story.so_far_ko: 요정 이가 구급상자를 연으로 바꿨어요. 벌집에서 벌이 나오자 그럼블이 "숨어!" 하고 알려 줬어요.
story.goal_ko: 마법 e 로 짧은 o 단어를 긴 o 단어로 바꿔 읽고 계단의 틈을 건너요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the tiny fairy taps the red no sign with her star wand, sparkles burst and the sign flips into a folded paper note that flutters down into the hedgehog's paws; he opens it and a little drawing of a rope shimmers. Camera still. Magical, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: the rabbit swings across the gap on a long rope with the baby bird on her head and her red cape flying, sparkles twinkle along the rope, the old raccoon in the window holds the rope tight and hides a small smile. Camera still. Exciting, child-friendly. No text.
